property_summary: For any target, calling freezeAccount(target, false) must leave the account unfrozen (and freezeAccount(target,true) must freeze it), i.e. frozenAccount[target] equals the freeze argument; the mutant always freezes, so a fuzzed target with freeze=false violates the invariant.
change_summary: Always set the target's frozenAccount entry to true regardless of the freeze parameter.
